caption: The drawing depicts a sleeveless, knee-length garment, resembling a patterned vest or coat, with a high, round neckline and a series of small, closely set buttonholes running down the front right side; the left front flap is open, revealing the interior. The garment is made of a light-colored fabric with a prominent, repetitive geometric pattern in shades of beige and gray, creating a diamond-like design across the surface. There are two horizontal flap pockets, one on each side near the waist, and the lower half of the vest flares outward, suggesting pleating or a full cut. The textured details and patterning of the fabric are rendered with careful, precise lines and shading, giving the garment a three-dimensional and slightly reflective appearance, set against a plain, light background. The artist’s signature “Ruggiero Pierotti” is visible in the lower left corner.
title: Man's Waistcoat
